purpose: Three original concept studies; not production App Store assets

briefs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand / premium macOS app icon concept. Create ONE original app icon for Ora, a calm real-time speech translation app. Direction A: FOLD / two languages passing from one to another. Front-facing orthographic icon, square 1024 composition; a warm porcelain-white gently rounded macOS tile occupies about 84% of the canvas, centered, transparent outside. The dominant symbol consists of TWO WIDE, SOLID, interlocking folded ribbon planes. An asymmetric angular upper fold travels down toward a complementary lower fold; a precise diagonal negative-space channel separates the two. Compact architectural silhouette, not a closed knot, not a letter. Saturated ultramarine and periwinkle ceramic-enamel surfaces, one small naturally shaded fold showing a meaningful change in plane. High craft, gently beveled substantial edges, a restrained top-left softbox reflection and contact shadows consistent with actual thickness. Think of a tiny beautifully manufactured object, not a flat glyph with a drop shadow. The symbol fills roughly 62% of the tile with balanced optical centering and generous breathing room. Minimal shape count, readable at 32 pixels. Entire tile visible, no perspective tilt, no background scene. No text, no letters, no slogans, no speech bubble, no microphone, no concentric circles, no center dot, no waveform bars, no sparkles, no neon glow, no rainbow, no copied existing logo. One icon only, no comparison sheet, no Dock mockup. Genuine transparent alpha outside the tile.

Use case: logo-brand / premium macOS app icon concept. Create ONE original app icon for Ora, a calm real-time speech translation app. Direction B: DUET / two voices in exchange. This must be a genuinely different silhouette from angular ribbons or a ring. Front-facing orthographic square 1024 composition, a softly warm ivory macOS rounded tile centered at 84% of canvas width, transparent outside. Symbol: TWO ORGANIC, SOLID, sculptural quotation-like curved ceramic forms, diagonally offset and facing inward toward a deliberate flowing gap. Each form is a wide soft bowl tapering once into a short rounded end; two pieces only, substantial and elegant, no enclosing circular outline and no tiny separate dots. One piece glazed terracotta-coral, the other a deeper warm vermilion with a subtle rose-lit edge. The composition should feel like two distinct voices answering each other, expressive but quiet and precise, balanced asymmetrically. Beautiful tactile satin ceramic, controlled highlights from a broad upper-left light, fine rounded bevels, soft realistic contact shadows. Strong clean outer silhouette and negative space, not an emoji, not a yin-yang, not a heart. Symbol occupies about 60% of the tile. No lettering or text, no chat bubbles, no O/Q shape, no generic infinity/knot, no microphone, no wave bars, no concentric circles, no arbitrary decorative flourishes, no neon/glitter. No scene, no fake Dock screenshot, one icon only. Transparent alpha outside the tile, complete uncropped tile, physically plausible refined materials, not plastic clipart.

Use case: logo-brand / premium macOS app icon concept. Create ONE original app icon for Ora, a real-time speech translation app. Direction C: LENS / turning incoming speech into clarity. This must be a genuinely different silhouette from ribbons, quotation marks, and circles. Front-facing orthographic 1024 square. A dark ink-navy macOS rounded tile centered and occupying 84% of the canvas; genuine transparent alpha outside. A SINGLE HORIZONTALLY ELONGATED, softly faceted optical lozenge, like an exquisitely cut translucent lens or smooth prismatic seed, is suspended slightly above the tile. A decisive oblique inner seam separates two large refracting surfaces; one face icy translucent silver-blue and the other deep cobalt, with a vivid restrained electric-blue edge where they meet. Compact sculptural optical object, roughly 62% of tile width and 39% of tile height, slightly asymmetric to imply passage left-to-right. Thick polished glass with coherent refraction and a thin pearly chamfer, subtle believable contact shadow, controlled soft studio lighting. Strong readable silhouette and a large simple interior division rather than lots of tiny glass facets. It must remain recognizable at small Dock sizes. No eye/iris/pupil, no text/letters, no O or Q, no speech bubble, no rings, no microphone, no wave bars, no sparkles, no gradients sprayed over the whole composition, no generic AI orb, no background scene, no other icons. One carefully designed icon, tile fully visible, no perspective tilt, no comparison board or Dock mockup.
